name: Rackrow
author: E. T. Carter
description: A long server aisle seen from just off its centre line: rows of racks recede to a lit doorway, every server blinking its own cluster of amber status lights, cable trays and louvred light strips overhead, the glossy tiled floor mirroring it all under a warm haze. A slow plane of scanning light sweeps back and forth along the aisle, catching every bezel it passes.

params.label: Scan speed
params.effect: How fast the plane of light sweeps back and forth along the aisle.

params.label: Lights
params.effect: Share of status and port lights that are lit, from a quiet hall to a busy one.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Thickness of the warm haze that swallows the far end of the aisle.
